name: village-language
description: MERN website to preserve and learn our village language

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.deploy:build: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
